scope: Ordinary BrotatoProjectile ranged interception plus real EnemySim target/clock adapter; no full Pachycephalosaurus actor or area.
rules: Intercept before Combat.hit: no damage, life steal, on-hit mine, secondary shot, explosion or pierce consumption; no permanent hit-ignore entry for the reflector.
Forced bounce decrements zero/negative bounce budgets, applies integer damage falloff once and clears all knockback. No other target uses random angle -PI..PI; coincident target angle is0.

Separate travelRange preserves the original weapon-stat range for later effects and Fire/End events use the correct flight cap. Native automatic-aim lifetime resets to (INFINITE_RANGE10000+additional100) pixels; manual aim is not connected.
Global source enemy pool includes living charmed ordinary actors, excludes bosses and the reflector, and does not filter earlier damaged targets. Rejected reflector draws consume random samples.
Temporary overlap state emulates area-enter behavior: no repeated interception until leaving the current hurt circle. Native geometry is read through the real Vector3/radius service API.
Melee-origin on-hit projectiles are not rejected merely because they are projectiles.
